title: Butternut Pumpkin Agnolotti
subtitle: with fennel seed butter and hazelnuts
description: Fresh egg pasta filled with roasted pumpkin and ricotta, tossed in browned fennel seed butter with hazelnuts and mascarpone.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Arrange diced pumpkin in a greased baking tray, brush with olive oil, scatter over the thyme, salt and brown sugar, and bake for about 1 hour until soft. Peel off the tough skin and mash well. Mix with the ricotta, parmesan and a little salt. Refrigerate until needed.

Mound the flour on a work surface and make a well in the centre. Pour in the eggs and 1 tbsp olive oil and mix only the eggs with a fork. Knead by hand for about 5 minutes until smooth. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Roll out half of the dough with a rolling pin, then through a pasta machine to one setting before the thinnest. Keep the other half covered with a towel so it does not dry out.

Pipe a long line of filling along the edge of the sheet, roll the dough over the filling into a tube, brush with a little water and roll once more. Cut the dough about 1 cm from the tube, pinch every 4 cm to make a chain of mounds, cut between them and pinch the ends of each agnolotti.
Boil in a large pot of salted water until the agnolotti float.

Melt the butter in a frying pan with the fennel seeds until it begins to turn golden. Add the pasta and toss gently. Transfer to a serving plate and scatter over the hazelnuts and dollops of mascarpone.
